name: gate-e2e-bare-author-inprocess-driver
body: Limits: realization is proven for a BARE (language-agnostic) authored planned FQN satisfied by the crate-prefixed scanned node; the crate-prefixed-authored case rides the exact-identity fast path and is not separately exercised — upgrade if FQN rendering or the crate-prefix rule changes. And: green/refusal verdicts are driven through plan_verify_at in-process against a real branch DB, not the `apg plan verify` child process, so the CLI's exit-code mapping is not exercised — upgrade if the CLI wrapper stops being a thin Err-to-exit mapping.
